what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17592 Syrian refugees in the United Kingdom, 0.4% of all refugees from Syria.
The largest numbers of Syrian refugees live in Türkiye, Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them, between the government and Syrian insurgents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025, and with the SDF over Rojava Kurdistan territory in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 22 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 19614, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
